methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: The "S" Snake (Third Person Singular)
content: Problem: Students often forget to add 's' or 'es' when talking about He/She/It in the present simple.

Solution: We introduce the concept of the "S" Snake. When we talk about "I" or "You", the verb is normal. But when we point to a friend ("He" or "She"), the "S" Snake attaches to the action word (wake → wakes, go → goes). TPR (Total Physical Response) is used to physically mimic adding an 's' to the end of the action.

methodology.title: 2.4 Teacher Notes: Pull-Out Tasks & Communicative Task
content: S1 pull-out: Show a time flashcard. Student must make an "I" sentence: "I wake up at 6:00."
S2 pull-out: Show an action flashcard. Student must make a "He/She" sentence: "He brushes his teeth."
Communicative task: Information Gap (Section 8). Student A knows Max's routine. Student B knows Luna's routine. They interview each other.

content: Max is a busy hero! Let's see his day.
Max wakes up at 6:30. He brushes his teeth.

games.name: Vocab Slam
games.session_fit: All formats — best after vocab intro (P3) in any session
games.materials: Vocab flashcards W13: wake up, brush teeth, eat breakfast, go to school, study
instructions: Round 1: Teacher calls a Vietnamese meaning — first student to say the English word AND use it correctly in a sentence wins the card.
Round 2: Reverse — teacher calls English word, student gives Vietnamese + memory trick.
Bonus round: Students chain all vocab words (wake up, brush teeth, eat breakfast, go to school, study) into one connected story using sequence connectors from this week.
Team variant: 2 teams, 10 cards per round. Team with highest score wins.

games.name: Grammar Relay
games.session_fit: Best in Drill slot (Slot 2) or after P4/P6 in 3-session mode
games.materials: 10 sentence cards — 5 correct, 5 with errors based on: Present Simple (I verb / He verbs)
instructions: Grammar focus this week: Present Simple (I verb / He verbs).
Speed Read: Display sentence for 5 sec. Teams write C (correct) or E (error) on whiteboards simultaneously — no copying allowed.
Fix-It: For error sentences, team that corrects fastest AND explains the rule earns double points.
Build: Each team member adds 1 original sentence using the grammar target. The chain must be logically connected — each sentence must link to the previous.

games.name: Story Race
games.session_fit: All formats — best in final slot of the week (S3 / Slot 5 / Session B)
games.materials: Story starter card: theme "Community & Routines — A Day in Hero Life"
instructions: Give each pair a story starter connected to this week's theme: "Community & Routines — A Day in Hero Life".
Pair A adds 2 sentences — must include at least 2 vocab words from this week.
Pass to Pair B: they MUST correct any grammar mistake from Pair A first, then add 2 more sentences using different vocab words.

Final round: Each pair presents their story ending aloud. Class votes on most creative + most accurate (wake up, brush teeth, eat breakfast, go to school, study usage). Teacher scores grammar precision.
